listing.name: Mario Kart 64 / MarioKart64Recomp
listing.summary: Mario Kart 64 / MarioKart64Recomp for your own North American original. Keep the complete Windows runtime and its profile together. Portcove does not manage replacing it.

warnings: The package includes Chiaro fonts by Fontworks that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
The reviewed v0.9.2 release currently supports single-player modes.

steps.title: Keep the complete runtime together
steps.instruction: Keep the complete upstream Windows runtime together with its assets and DLLs. The player is MarioKart64Recompiled.exe; select that executable and use its containing folder as the working directory. Retain any existing portable.txt choice. Registration preserves external ownership and does not execute setup or the game.

steps.title: Supply your original when you choose Play
steps.instruction: Save the reviewed launch details, then choose Play explicitly. The upstream player selects and validates your own matching North American Mario Kart 64 original; keep it available and follow its edition checks. No local compiler or separate installer is needed for the reviewed Windows package.

steps.title: Preserve the actual profile before updating
steps.instruction: You or upstream replace this external runtime. Close the game and preserve its original, saves, settings and mods at the actual current profile location. Windows normally uses %LOCALAPPDATA%/MarioKart64Recompiled/; portable.txt mode instead uses the working folder beside the runtime. Keep the old working copy until the successor can read your data. Removing registration preserves every external file. External registration does not provide managed Update, Backup or Rollback.

steps.title: Linux and macOS copies
steps.instruction: The reviewed Linux ZIP contains MarioKart64Recompiled.tar.gz: unpack both layers yourself before registering the existing player. Keep the complete upstream macOS application bundle and follow its setup instructions. Normal data roots are ~/.config/MarioKart64Recompiled/ on Linux and ~/Library/Application Support/MarioKart64Recompiled/ on macOS; portable mode instead uses the working folder or bundle-parent folder containing portable.txt. Preserve that actual location separately.
